Reflective content

Astra provides practical reflection tools and optional astrology-based content for personal growth, business, career, money, timing and decisions. Astrology and AI-generated interpretations support self-reflection and entertainment. They do not guarantee future events or outcomes and are not financial, investment, medical, legal, tax or other professional advice. You remain responsible for your decisions and should use real-world evidence and qualified professionals for high-stakes matters.

Accounts and personalization

Local paths, practices and journal features can be used without an account. Server-backed personalized readings and Compass require a signed-in account, a calculated local birth profile and your explicit permission to process derived context. AI output may be incomplete or mistaken. Do not submit information you do not want processed. You can withdraw personalization consent in Settings.

You are responsible for maintaining access to your authentication method and for activity through your account. Astra must not be used unlawfully, to harm others, to bypass access controls or to interfere with service security or operation. Astra may restrict access when necessary to protect users, the service or comply with law.

Subscriptions

Astra Plus features may require an auto-renewable subscription. Apple shows the price, billing period and any eligible introductory offer before an in-app purchase. Manage or cancel Apple subscriptions through your Apple Account settings. Restore eligible Apple purchases through the app.

Version 1.8 can also recognize eligible existing Stripe web subscriptions under the same Astra account. Manage those subscriptions through the original web billing provider. Access depends on verified current entitlement. Deleting your Astra account does not cancel an Apple or Stripe subscription. Refund requests follow the relevant provider’s process and applicable rights.

Local records and account deletion

Your journal and extended birth profile are stored locally and do not automatically synchronize between devices. Uninstalling the app or losing a device may remove local records; device backups depend on your Apple settings. Account deletion removes the shared Astra account and its associated server data across Astra apps, as explained in the app and Privacy Policy.
